name: Jobdigger
niche: vacancy data aggregation for intermediaries and labour market analysis
business_model: SaaS, price on request via online demo
notes: Site says: "© 2026 Jobdigger B.V." Site says: "Jobdigger en BCS HR Software slaan de handen ineen en gaan de samenwerking aan als partners." Labour market data and SaaS for intermediaries, career professionals and municipalities, not employers. Legal entity Jobdigger B.V. Available inside most ATS systems per the homepage. Headquarters and parent not stated.

review.note: Homepage and partners page state language options, demo-only pricing and a partner program; the /partnern/ link returned 404 in the browser reader and /partners/ was readable.
